title: 폐관 오 분 전
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie pop with bossa nova influences. The arrangement features a nylon-string acoustic guitar playing syncopated jazz chords and a walking upright bass. A clean electric guitar provides melodic counterpoint with light chorus and reverb. Percussion consists of a shaker, a soft woodblock, and a drum kit played with brushes, emphasizing a swung eighth-note feel. The female vocals are delivered in a breathy, intimate head voice with minimal vibrato. The track is in the key of E Major at 105 BPM in 4/4 time. The production is dry and transparent, focusing on the natural timbre of the acoustic instruments.
